Thanks Naomi —

We can support a temporary no-PO lane for short pilots provided the vendor supplies the evidence below and we create a simple exception record in the procurement tracker. My proposal: approve up to $7,000 total spend for up to 45 days from the first invoice date. Conditions:

Required evidence (must be uploaded to the HubSpot procurement ticket):
- Completed supplier intake (tally_supplier_form.pdf)
- Current W9 (PDF)
- Confirmation of legal entity (link to company registry or DUNS)
- A single consolidated invoice template that includes remit-to and billing contact
- Pilot statement of work (one page) with estimated spend and dates
- PO-waiver acknowledgement signed by Tally (simple DocuSign)

Operational notes:
- Invoices will route to Finance but be coded to a temporary "pilot" cost center.
- Finance will place payments on a delayed approval hold until the exception record is closed.
- If spend exceeds $7k or pilot goes beyond 45 days we require conversion to a standard PO.

If legal is comfortable with the waiver phrasing I'll send them a DocuSign template. I'll create the HubSpot ticket and attach the terms.

Attachment: no_po_pilot_terms.docx
